name: ST DENIO

music.name: Welsh melody
music.role: Melody, printed in John Roberts's Caniadau y Cyssegr (1839)

source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (The Hymnal 1940); the harmony in the same source confirms each melody note.
reviewNotes: High, from one source. Check bars 2–3: the falling thirds with leaps up (doh | lah, fah, ray | te, soh, doh), which sit low at the start (down to ray, D above middle C).
